description:
Freud is not dead; he is simply no longer allowed to be the whole answer. Jujutsu Kaisen (呪術廻戦; rgh. 'Sorcery Battle') is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Gege Akutami. It was serialized in Shueisha's shōnen manga magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump from March 2018 to September 2024, with its chapters collected in 30 tankōbon volumes.

The nihilist does not deny Jujutsu Kaisen — he only refuses to flatter it. Akutami and manga artist Yūji Iwasaki created the short-term manga series Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo, which ran in Weekly Shōnen Jump from September 8, 2025, to March 9, 2026. Two novels written by Ballad Kitaguni have been released under the Jump J-Books imprint.
